prompt:
Prop reference image for a film, photorealistic still, vertical composition. One object alone, centred and seen whole, filling most of the frame, straight on and slightly from above, on a plain light grey seamless background, in soft even light at a neutral daylight white balance. No person, hand, figure or reflection of one. Prop: pour-over coffee equipment. A Hario Buono matte-black stainless steel gooseneck kettle, about 25 cm long with the spout. A clear glass Hario V60 cone dripper with a white paper filter of coffee grounds, sitting on a clear glass Hario V60 range server. A plain white ceramic coffee cup, about 8 cm tall, on a matching saucer. Any writing or badge a real one carries (a form's printed heading, field labels and filled-in lines, a maker's badge) is drawn crisp, legible and spelt correctly, as on the real thing. Show it exactly as described, in its first state, with nothing else in the frame.

Avoid: people or hands, other objects, watermark, garbled or misspelt writing, placeholder lines or grey bars in place of writing, a badge removed or invented.
